purpose: preview-only art direction study; no production integration

variants.name: stylized-metal
variants.prompt:
DIRECTION A — PREMIUM STYLIZED 3D MECHA, CLEAN SATIN METAL. The main requirement is a convincing smooth physically based CGI render, not painted game art. Think carefully manufactured die-cast machinery with generous machined bevels, satin enamel armor, metallic barrel reflections and soft rubber joints. Clean large shapes, slightly exaggerated armor thickness, precise material transitions, restrained two-tone roughness and only a handful of small corner scuffs. Crisp light-to-shadow volume, visible panel depth and global illumination. Warm approachable industrial style. Avoid black outlines and sketch-like white scratches entirely.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a NEW landscape 3:2 studio asset presentation with exactly four rendered 3D objects from the reference designs. This must look like geometry rendered in a physically based 3D renderer, with continuous curved surface shading and reflections. It must NOT look like an illustration, hand-painted texture, comic, line art, or a drawing with extra highlights.

Reference role: the three attached atlases provide ONLY object identity, colors and mechanical silhouettes, NOT the drawing style. Ignore their ink contours and texture treatment completely.
From image 1 actors.png, assemble the scavenger in row 1 using the short leg pair in row 5 column 1 and energy backpack in row 6 column 1. It is a BIPED: exactly TWO feet standing side by side, no other legs behind them. Round ivory torso is also its head; black circular glass face has two vertical cyan eyes; orange shoulder shells and a cyan glass cylinder backpack. Compact and stout; no tall humanoid neck/head. Fit a small orange rivet weapon beside one shoulder.
From image 2 modules.png, show the detached orange rivet gun in row 1 column 1 and the orange rectangular battery with three cyan tubes in row 5 column 1.
From image 3 enemies.png, show the small red beetle robot in row 1 column 1, with one orange-red round eye and squat articulated dark legs.

Layout identical across direction studies: complete hero occupying the left 50% of canvas; detached right-pointing rivet gun at upper-right; battery lower middle-right; enemy lower far-right. Separate objects with ample empty space. No overlaps or crops. The hero has exactly TWO short legs.
Camera: orthographic three-quarter product view from above, 30 degrees elevation, front and right-side volumes visible. Show clearly modeled depths and thick armor panels. Broad top-left studio softbox, balanced neutral fill. A pale cool gray seamless studio background and subtle contact shadows under objects to explain volume. NO dark background, painted halo or outlines.
Keep the reference palette: warm orange and ivory armor, dark graphite machinery, cyan energy glass. Enemy rust-red and dark metal with an amber-red lens. Sharp readable silhouettes, controlled bright energy accents, premium polished output. No text, captions, letters, numbers, logo, UI, watermark, borders, decorative extra objects.

variants.name: industrial-metal
variants.prompt:
DIRECTION B — PHOTOREAL INDUSTRIAL MINIATURE, TACTILE HEAVY METAL. Render a real constructed miniature photographed in a professional product studio. Use physically accurate metals, fine casting grain, subtly rough orange powder-coat paint, ceramic ivory armor, brushed stainless-steel barrel, machined bolts and joints, rubber hose surfaces and clear thick energy glass. Real specular reflections and material roughness, tiny wear at functional contact edges, controlled assembly grease, mostly intact colored paint. Keep the references' cute compact shapes, but make material weight and physical fabrication very convincing. No ink stroke, no painterly edges, no toon shader, no flat comic texture, no humanoid redesign.

variants.name: rounded-toy
variants.prompt:
DIRECTION C — CLEAN ROUNDED ANIMATED-FILM 3D, DESIGNER-TOY FINISH. Render smooth beautifully sculpted three-dimensional forms with large soft radii and generous bevels, minimalist panel detailing, unblemished satin polymer/enamel shells, soft graphite rubber joints and colored translucent energy glass. Slightly plumper proportions, fewer tiny fasteners, extremely clean broad orange/ivory color blocks. Diffuse light wraps smoothly around round volumes, rich gentle occlusion in joints, soft specular highlights, polished tactile collectible quality. No battle damage, no texture noise, no paint chips. It must look like a softly lit physical 3D sculpture with solid depth, not vector art, hand-painted concept art, line drawing or plastic illustration. Friendly and bold at mobile scale.
